notes.title: Happy Lunar new year from Rusty Winter
notes.content:
Fellow mates,

From January 27th to February 10th, [i]Rusty Winter[/i] will be part of Steam's Lunar New Year Sale. All of us at Ino Kinwen extend our heartfelt wishes to our incredible Asian player community.

As we welcome the new year, we’re continuing to actively work on [i]Rusty Winter[/i]. Thank you for your support, and don’t forget to add our game to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3290380/_/

[i]Rusty Winter[/i] is a sidescrolling adventure game inspired by hardboiled detective stories and urban legends. Meet a diverse cast, chase down leads that blur the boundaries between reality and the paranormal, and explore a cold, once-glorious industrial town in search of your missing loved one.

Wishing you all a Happy New Year in the Year of the Snake!

The [i]Rusty Winter[/i] Team
